## Summary
Sprint 3 successfully delivered and accepted all planned sprint backlog items: US-0005 (Control Server Job Queue and Dispatcher) and US-0004 (Docker Container Job Runner on Client Daemon). Together with previous sprints, this completes the entire v0.1 MVP feature scope for distributed job execution across the cluster. ## Accomplishments
- Successfully implemented and accepted US-0005 (Control Server Job Queue and Dispatcher), providing concurrent JobQueue state machine, capacity-aware scheduling, and automatic heartbeat timeout failover.

- Completed 100% of planned Sprint 3 user stories (2/2) within budget, completing all user stories for the v0.1 MVP milestone.
- Integrated all changes into develop via feature PRs #13 and #14 with verified unit tests, architectural sign-off, and QA verification.
